preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the input string S must be between 8 and 40 characters.

preconditions.expression: ('@' in S) or (any(c.isdigit() for c in S))
preconditions.description: The input string S must contain either an '@' symbol or digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout == S.lower() if '@' in S else stdout == f'+**-***-***-{local_number[-4:]}'
postconditions.description: If S is an email, the output must be the email with the first name masked. If S is a phone number, the output must be the masked local number.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len(S) if '@' in S else len(stdout) == 12 or len(stdout) == 14
postconditions.description: The length of the output must match the input length for emails, and must be 12 or 14 characters for phone numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('*') == 5 if '@' in S else stdout.count('*') == 10
postconditions.description: The output must contain 5 asterisks for email masking and 10 asterisks for phone number masking.
